## Goal

Implement the tokens and primitives from `docs/DESIGN.md` and a homepage prototype for approval (D-005).

## Context

Current UI uses Inter + Barlow via `next/font/google`, ALL CAPS buttons and a TODO brand-colour block in `globals.css`. Primitives exist in `src/components/ui`. This package runs in parallel with the security work, so its file ownership is strict.

## Scope

- Tokens in `globals.css` `@theme` (colours, radius, spacing, type scale).
- Geist Sans/Mono from the `geist` npm package (self-hosted) replacing `next/font/google` (removes a build-time network fetch). Justify the dependency in the PR.
- Restyle existing primitives (Button, Input, Card, States, ResultIndicator), contrast tests for every text token pair in `src/lib/design/contrast.test.ts`.
- Homepage prototype on its own preview route, real data or an honest empty state only; screenshots at 375 and 1280 px in the PR.
- **The preview route must not be reachable in public production.** It answers 404 in production mode, decided from the already validated `NODE_ENV` rather than a new setting, because `src/lib/env.ts` belongs to SC-017 and SC-018. Once the launch gate from SC-017 exists, the route moves behind it. State in the PR how the owner reviews it meanwhile: screenshots, plus a local or staging run in development mode.

## Out of scope

- Redesigning other pages (SC-006/007/008).
- Copy changes beyond button casing.
- New component libraries.
- `src/components/layout/*`, the current homepage, the history pages and the analysis detail: those belong to SC-017, SC-006, SC-007 and SC-024.
- Any change to `src/lib/env.ts`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Owner approves or rejects the direction in the PR (recorded in D-005).
- [ ] Contrast tests pass for all token pairs used for text.
- [ ] No layout shift from font loading (CLS check on the prototype route).
- [ ] No mock numbers.
- [ ] A production build does not serve the preview route, proven by a test.
- [ ] No file outside the owned list is touched.

## Required tests

- Standard checks.
- Lighthouse mobile run on the prototype route (LCP, CLS, accessibility score) pasted.
- Keyboard pass and an axe check of the prototype.
- A test that the preview route is absent in production mode.

## Dependencies

- SC-003

P1 · Phase A
